title: Noble Smoky Turkish Stilton Kebabs
description: Indulging fluffy kebabs that fuse smoky Turkish flavors with creamy Stilton cheese and a subtle tempering chocolate glaze, served sizzling from a wok.
instructions: In a bowl combine ground chickpeas, flour, smoked paprika, cumin, chili flakes, salt and pepper until a sticky mixture forms.
Fold in the cubed Stilton cheese until it is evenly distributed throughout the mixture.
Shape the mixture into oval patties about 4 cm long using wet hands to prevent sticking.
Heat a wok over medium-high heat, add olive oil, and swirl to coat the bottom.
Place the kebabs in a single layer in the wok, leaving space between them, and sear for 2-3 minutes on each side until golden brown.
Reduce the heat to medium, pour the melted chocolate over the kebabs, and let it coat and caramelize for 1-2 minutes.
Flip the kebabs again to evenly coat with chocolate glaze, cooking another 1-2 minutes until the sauce sets.
Remove the kebabs from the wok and rest them on a paper towel to absorb excess oil before serving hot.
Optionally garnish with chopped fresh herbs and drizzle extra melted chocolate for a glossy finish.
